positions.title: Software Engineer, Front End
positions.description:
Leading and working on new verticals (grocery-perishables, retail) web initiatives

React, GraphQL, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, Redux, Express, Node.js, Nginx, grpc, Scalyr, Sentry, Amplitude, Mode, Segment, Chronosphere

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Built the user interface for the Chat-Bot Project. Designed a solution that requires minimal network calls for the communication between sponsors’ contents and the WebMD site. Used WebdriverIO for end-to-end testing. Collaborated with other developers in an agile environment and completed two full sprints.
• Worked in a team of three to improve the user interface and functionality of the company’s API development platform. Utilized AngularJS for development process and used grunt to automate build and deployment process.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description:
•	Assist faculty and doctoral students in carrying out their research projects.
•	Provide assistance with setting up and conducting experiments. Troubleshoot problems occurred during the studies.
•	Perform data analysis on survey responses using SPSS. Develop strategies to recruit participants for the studies.

company.name: Johnson Graduate School of Management at Cornell University

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Introduction to Robotics Course
positions.description:
• Worked with the instructor to plan all lessons.
• Taught computer science concepts to students, including topics on sequential control flow and developing algorithms.
• Assisted students with their Lego Mindstorms robotics projects.
